# PR #5084: Patch: every card whose text acts while it is in play prints "Aura:"

Closes #5039

§6.2's Aura row now says which text prints "Aura:", and a new ruling, **R5039000**, records the decision. The rule: standing text that works while its card is face-up and acting on the field, and that reaches beyond the card (other cards on either side, a player's rules or a hero), prints "Aura:". A card's text about itself prints bare, the way a keyword does.

I measured every card by what its script sets, not by how its text looks. That flagged 20 cards that gain the label and 6 that lose it. For all 26, these now agree:
- the English text (`catalog.json`);
- the Chinese text (`card-text.yaml` → `chinese.json`, 光环：);
- the §8 and §7 rows;
- three short forms;
- the quotes in the script headers.

A new test, `crates/cards/tests/cross/aura_label.rs`, runs on every pull request. It fails when a script sets a standing effect and the text has no "Aura:", or the reverse. Every allowlist entry gives its reason.

Only wording changed: no number, keyword, script behaviour or `loc`. `classify` agrees ("Cards, micro", wording only).

## Every face the measure flagged

**I checked all 1,234 catalog entries (cards and tokens, Infinite Assault and Training Grounds included), both faces of each: 2,468 faces.**

A face's script counts as setting a **standing hook** when it sets any of these:
- `aura`, `cost_aura`, `hero_guard`, `draw_limit`, `discard_guard`, `attack_mods`, `graveyard_play`, `reveal_echo`;
- `turn_hook_extra`, `cry_death_extra`, `death_extra`, `reborn_extra`, `evolve_extra`, `trades_per_turn`;
- a non-empty `exile_auras`, or `resolves_set_spells`;
- a field `replacements` entry on a face that is not a Trap;
- one of the 30 static flags sorted as auras (`AURA_FLAGS`).

The other 54 static flags that cards set are sorted as not an aura, each with its reason (`NOT_AURA_FLAGS`). A flag added later fails the test until someone sorts it.

## Decisions the issue left open

- **A card's text about itself prints bare** (R5039000). "This can't go Berserk", "This is a 2X/2X" and "Has N random combat keywords" carry no label. This drops M #65's precedent ("Aura: Has …", R781004), so M #65, S #111, the two Drone tokens, S+ #87 and S+ #163 lose the label.
  - *Rejected:* labelling own text the way M #65 did. That would put "Aura:" on about forty more keyword-like lines, for example "Damage also Burns" on fifteen S+ cards, and say nothing a keyword doesn't.
  - Hearthstone also prints a minion's own ongoing text bare ("Has +1 Attack for each other minion").
  - To take the other reading instead: add the label to the own-text group and move those flags into `AURA_FLAGS`.
- **The words decide, not the engine.** A field trigger whose line names no moment of its own still prints "Aura:" (C #87, M #11, S #37, S+ #74), and so does text the engine runs itself (S #148). Those five are allowlisted. *Rejected:* measuring by script alone, because field triggers run standing words and some static flags are keywords.
- **A face has one "Aura:" line.** Core #73's Radiant face joins its two standing sentences, as C #28 already does: "Aura: Your hero can't take more than {cap} damage at a time. Your hero has Armor {armor}." *Rejected:* two "Aura:" lines on one face.
- **A Trap's replacement is its reveal condition**, so the measure does not count it on a Trap or Field Trap face.
- **The issue's step 2 lists `conditional_keywords` and `set_stat` as standing hooks.** The measure leaves them out, with `stat_line_when`, `plague_multiplier`, `targeting_discards` and `combat_keywords_follow`. Every card that sets them uses them for its own text, which R5039000 prints bare. The test's module doc says so.

## How I tested it

- **The measure, before and after.** On the untouched catalog, `cargo test -p jackioh-cards --test cards aura_label` failed exactly as the plan predicted:
  - 18 scripted cards had no label;
  - the 4 own-text "Has …" cards printed one;
  - 4 allowlist entries did not apply yet.

  After the edits it is green.
- **The guard works.** With `Aura: ` deleted from `core-001`'s base text, the first test failed with `core-001 base: its script sets ["aura"] but no line starts "Aura:"`. I restored the catalog from a copy, and `git diff crates/cards/catalog.json` shows no `core-001` line.
- **classify.** It reads commits, and HEAD still equals `origin/main`, so on HEAD it saw an empty diff ("Internal"). I ran it instead on a dangling `git commit-tree` object of the working tree; no ref, index or HEAD moved. It printed `classify: Cards, micro`, wording only, on the 20 shipped ids, and exited 0 with `--claims`.
- **Rust suites:**
  - `cargo test -p jackioh-cards`: 11,139 + 1,275 passed, 0 failed.
  - `cargo test -p jackioh-tools`: lib 641 passed (25 ignored), every integration binary passed.
  - `export_card_text`: 4 passed after its first run rewrote `chinese.json`, as it should.
  - `cargo test -p jackioh-shared --features jackioh-engine/testkit`: 331 + 684 passed.
- **Checks:** `cargo clippy -p jackioh-cards --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --check` are clean. `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `patches check` and `spec check` ("2677 rulings … ok") are green.
- **Web**, after `sh scripts/build-wasm.sh`:
  - the plan's six files (`textLimit`, `chinese`, `rules`, `lessons`, `aura-keywords-real`, `wording`): 118 tests passed;
  - the harness's own selection, `pnpm exec vitest run --project web --changed origin/main` with its excludes: 480 files, 9,382 passed, 169 skipped, 0 failed.

- **Old words left on purpose:**
  - the engine's rule-test fixtures (`crates/engine/tests/rules/*`), which carry their own texts;
